changelog: v1.1.2 - Notification fix: leave, holiday, payslip and broadcast alerts now reach your phone, not just the in-app list
features: Notification fix: push notifications now reach your phone for leave approvals, holidays, payslips, document status, and broadcasts - not just the in-app notifications list
Attendance fix: punch-in/out time and "hours worked today" now show correctly
In-app update: download with a progress bar and install without leaving the app
Bank details section in the profile edit screen, with IFSC auto-fill for bank name/branch
"Add Holiday" action in Admin's and HR's header menu
